newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares close lower, ignore Wall St rise.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares close lower, ignore Wall St rise.

text.p: 1452 GMT - Dutch shares finish lower, ending a five-session run of consecutive record high closings as investors trim profits in a low-volume day, despite fresh gains on Wall Street. Dealers say underlying trend, however, remains firm and charts point to further gains in medium term.
* AEX share index closes 3.62 points lower at 827.15, although 850 is seen as reachable near-term resistance.
* Aegon down 3.90 guilders to 142.90 as investors see Providian unit deal completion as signal to take profit.
* Philips loses 3.20 guilders to 113.80 on profit taking after a run which has seen it as high as 120.80 guilders.
